limits: Scoped cases; complete default suite not rerun. Paired control timings use retained previous-round baseline, not simultaneous ABBA. Phone viewport uses emulated touch for controls and keyboard drive. No Windows or physical-phone verification. Copy preserves authored settings, not live tilt/velocity/task bindings. Recompile restarts velocities/time. Existing publication boundary is unchanged, not a newly crash-atomic edit. Baseline starter and candidate custom wall differ, so contact results do not establish dynamic superiority.
